## Change

Describe what changed and list the entity IDs, article paths, or issue numbers.

## Evidence and dating

For each new or changed claim or dating, give the source ID and link, locator if known, evidence grade, and why that grade fits.
For datings, include the method, range, and any competing positions supported by the evidence.
For corrections, give the corrections log target.

## Checks

- [ ] I ran `npm run content:check -- <changed files> --write-cache` for content changes and included any cache changes it produced.
- [ ] I ran `npm run content:validate` and included the results below.
- [ ] New entities and articles have draft review status.
